intro.title: Accurate legal translation, delivered on time
paras: Legal translations are handled by legal translation experts and solicitors. We always work towards a precise deadline and deliver your documents on time.
An extensive terminology database, with glossaries and translation memories, is available to all our translators. Your legal documents are translated more quickly and consistently.
checks: Experienced translators who are experts in their field
Your confidentiality is guaranteed, with an NDA on request
Efficient solutions for official and corporate legal translation
A specialised international network across many language combinations

services.lead: From contracts to certificates, each file goes to a translator with legal experience.
